newsitem.title: MEXICO: Emvasa rights offering is approved.
newsitem.headline: Emvasa rights offering is approved.

text.p: Shareholders of Mexico's Embotelladores del Valle de Anahuac S.A. de C.V. (Emvasa) have approved an new rights offering of 16,422,264 shares that will raise up to $7.8 million in capital, a company official said on Monday.

"Yes, it was approved by a majority, there was only an abstention rate of three percent," Eduardo Macias, a finance official with the company, told Reuters. There were no votes against the proposal, he said.
Macias said 80 percent of the new shares would belong to the Rello family, the majority shareholders, with the remainder being offered to current shareholders.
Shareholders must buy 10 new shares for each one they currently hold. Any shares not claimed will be canceled, he said.
Emvasa will use the new cash to help pay off debts, Macias said.
